markdown:
Some mantises have unusually strong connections to elemental power. Though they lack the training to cultivate this energy, when orchid mantises gather at a place of abundant food or overflowing natural energy, they can bring trees to bloom in the depths of winter or turn any stretch of ground into a garden. Despite their beauty, gathering in large groups only seems to exacerbate the mantises' tempers. Although the mantises are individually harmless, anyone disturbing the countless false blossoms is likely to be recognized as food, no matter their size. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 22 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 [Orchid Mantis Swarm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2778) **Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 292 **Perception** +12; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69) **Languages** **Skills** [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +16 **Str** -2 **Dex** +4 **Con** +1 **Int** -5 **Wis** +2 **Cha** -4 **Floral Camouflage** When Hiding, the orchid mantis swarm is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other creatures concealed. --- **AC** 24 **Fort** +13 **Ref** +16 **Will** +12 **HP** 100 **Immunities** precision, swarm mind **Resistances** bludgeoning 2, piercing 5, slashing 5 **Weaknesses** area damage 5, splash damage 5 --- **Speed** 30 feet, climb 20 feet, fly 20 feet **Biting Blossoms** Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save). Creatures that fail this save also take 1d4 [persistent bleed damage.](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Drifting Petals** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The swarm Flies. Each creature whose space it moves through must attempt a DC 24 Will save or be transfixed by their blossom-like bodies. **Critical Success** No effect.
**Success** The creature is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is dazzled and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The creature is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) and stupefied 2 for 1 round.
